text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (――I want to prove it.)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(...Just how far I can run. Just how high 
I can climb—)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(These feelings are the very fire in my 
inner furnace——)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(The heat needed to reforge the "iron" 
that is me, and temper my will even 
further—)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —Haaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Haa... Haa... Haa...――

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: …………All menus completed.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(...I managed to finish earlier than 
expected. In that case, I'll use this time 
to write a letter to Teacher――)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Alright, done.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(――Professor. At long last, I have been 
assigned a dedicated Trainer.)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(Full-scale training for my debut finally 
begins tomorrow—)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(Once again... the reason I was able to 
pass through the narrow gates of Tracen 
Academy was thanks to Sensei's teachings—)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(I believe it was only possible thanks to 
the skills of "maintenance" and 
"management.")

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(—There are so many wonderful Umamusume at 
this academy, brimming with talent and 
passion.)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(From now on, I will be competing against 
them in races, but—)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(With an 'iron will' and no fear, I intend 
to run through the Twinkle Series.)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (And I will definitely prove it.)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(The possibilities brought about by 
"maintenance" and "management," and—)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That I am an Umamusume who can run 
endlessly――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Today marks the beginning of my days in 
the Twinkle Series with Ikuno Dictus...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus is the very first Umamusume 
I've trained. I want to help her run 
healthy and strong for as long as she 
desires.
choice_data_list:
(I've got to brace myself and get fired 
up...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because the days of challenging the future 
with her that were about to begin were 
bound to be unimaginably harsh—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...The Twinkle Series, racing itself, is 
a brilliant world that brings great 
emotion to people."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The magnificent runs of countless 
Umamusume... and the glory of their 
victories, have given birth to wild 
fervor.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet, on the other side of such a dazzling 
world—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
History proves beyond doubt that many 
Umamusume have had their tracks cut short 
by tragic injuries and illnesses.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's two sides of the same coin—just as a 
blindingly bright light casts a dark, deep 
shadow.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Racing moves people's hearts.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That excitement is born precisely because 
every Umamusume runs with everything she 
has toward victory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...However, precisely because it demands 
everything, racing is harsh. And because 
it is harsh, unforeseen tragedies occur—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—As a Trainer, I want to protect the 
Umamusume from such tragedies and support 
the dreams they hold...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus, who signed a contract with a 
Trainer like me, spoke of her goal a while 
ago like this—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—To keep running longer than anyone, and 
pile up more victories than anyone.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"That is the conclusion I reached— the 
ultimate 'goal' to prove my own racing 
ability and the teachings of my mentor."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Not just to keep running, but to keep 
winning.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As clever as she is, she must know full 
well just how difficult that is in the 
racing world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet, the light in her eyes as she stated 
this was powerful.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her unyielding resolve, I felt a 
strong desire to make her dream come true—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a refreshed mindset, I arrived at the 
track for our first day of training with 
Ikuno Dictus—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: —Turbo is the stroooongggeeeessst!!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Aaaand they reach the goooaaal!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: ――Ikuno, Ikuno! How was my time just now?!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Magnificent...! You've finally beaten your 
personal best.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Turbo thought so too! Because my 
engine was running full throttle all the 
way to the goal!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno, thanks a lot for watching my runs! 
In the next mock race, Turbo's gonna blow 
everyone away!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Man, even though her debut's already set, 
Ikuno is still as much of a mother hen as 
ever."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Right! But Turbo's running has actually 
gotten way better, which is amazing.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, maybe I should let 
Ikuno manage me too~.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
If my free time works for you, I'd be glad 
to. Shall we start by setting our goals?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Wait, seriously?! I was only joking, but 
is this what they call... having a shot?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Now, now~ don't go thinking you've got a 
chance.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You're going to get busier from now on 
too, Ikuno, so don't overdo it with 
looking after others.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
âSee? Looks like your Trainer just got 
here at the perfect time, too.
choice_data_list: Sorry, did I keep you waiting?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No, you're right on time. I was just 
chatting with everyone personally.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It turns out Ikuno Dictus had been helping 
her classmate with training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She is Nice Nature. Calm and composed, and 
as Ikuno Dictus put it, "a very dependable 
person"—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume in the hat is 
Matikanetannhauser. Bright and cheerful, 
Ikuno Dictus describes her as "someone who 
brings immense peace of mind," and—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The one running earlier was Twin Turbo. 
She's bursting with energy—or as Ikuno 
Dictus put it, "a person who gives you a 
tremendous boost of vitality."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus and those girls seemed to be 
very close friends, just as she had told 
me beforehand.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If I keep on running, maybe one day I'll 
have the chance to race alongside them, 
too."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The slightly cheerful way Ikuno Dictus 
said those words left a lasting impression 
on me—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—Alright then, guess we'll clear out. 
Ikuno, don't overdo it, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Turbo & Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno--!! See you later--!! Go get 'em, 
Ikuno~!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"—Shall we get started, then? I've already 
finished warming up with Turbo-san during 
our training."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the first day of training with 
Ikuno Dictus began right on schedule—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—We proceeded by checking Ikuno Dictus's 
current running form, and by the time 
everything was done, the sun was beginning 
to set.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —Thank you for your hard work today.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Having you watch in person like this 
truly brings an improvement in quality 
that is completely different from solo 
practice.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to working with you from 
now on as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With training finished like this, I take 
out what I had been meaning to give Ikuno 
Dictus for a while now.
choice_data_list:
Before the day is over, I want you to have 
this.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Is this... an app? From the looks of it, 
some kind of management app—
choice_data_list:
It's an app that was prototyped at Tracen 
Academy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This app was created to centrally manage 
various Umamusume data, such as schedules, 
physical condition, and race times.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Developed for the brighter future of 
Umamusume, this app features cutting-edge 
technology such as AI-assisted management, 
and—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The academy had been recruiting testers 
for this app among the trainers on campus.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sensing this as an opportunity, I was the 
first to volunteer as a tester.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To fight through the days ahead, I will 
utilize every bit of knowledge and 
technique available. This app is one part 
of that.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...I see. So my management data can be 
shared with you through this app, Trainer. 
This is quite convenient.
choice_data_list: Let's manage things together from now on.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. That is very reassuring. In that 
case, I will gratefully use this app—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...Does this app not have a name? Even on 
the home screen, it's just listed as 
'Prototype'—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Come to think of it, I remembered that 
we also asked the testers for app name 
suggestions.
choice_data_list:
I think we're free to name it whatever we 
like.
I think we can name it whatever we like.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...I see. In that case, may I make a 
suggestion?"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...How about 'IRON WILL'?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
In my own way, I tried to express our 
future path together in the form of a 
name, but...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For those of us who want to walk straight 
forward with an iron will... it's the 
absolute best name ever...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...You're too kind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, the name "IRON WILL" proposed 
by Ikuno Dictus was etched into the app—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so began the long days of challenges 
alongside Ikuno Dictus!
